---
name: Adapt Template Screen
description: 'Adapt one referenced template screen to an existing CBW route without copying its implementation.'
argument-hint: 'Template route, target CBW screen, intended outcome, and real data source.'
agent: agent
---

Use `update-cbw-screen`. Inspect the named template route and target CBW screen, explain the selected composition in one sentence, then adapt it with local Vite/client components, local primitives, and existing business contracts. Do not import or copy template code.
